name: dsh-boost
description: Cut DeepSeek Harness token usage by projecting tool receipts and substituting deterministic read-only calls.
config.projection.read.triggerChars: Project a read receipt only when it exceeds this many characters.
config.projection.read.headChars: Characters kept from the head of a read receipt.
config.projection.read.tailChars: Characters kept from the tail of a read receipt.
config.projection.grep.triggerChars: Project a grep receipt only when it exceeds this many characters.
config.projection.grep.headChars: Characters kept from the head of a grep receipt.
config.projection.grep.tailChars: Characters kept from the tail of a grep receipt.
config.projection.glob.triggerChars: Project a glob receipt only when it exceeds this many characters.
config.projection.glob.headChars: Characters kept from the head of a glob receipt.
config.projection.glob.tailChars: Characters kept from the tail of a glob receipt.
config.projection.bash.triggerChars: Project a bash receipt only when it exceeds this many characters.
config.projection.bash.headChars: Characters kept from the head of a bash receipt.
config.projection.bash.tailChars: Characters kept from the tail of a bash receipt.
config.projection.ssh.triggerChars: Project an ssh receipt only when it exceeds this many characters.
config.projection.ssh.headChars: Characters kept from the head of an ssh receipt.
config.projection.ssh.tailChars: Characters kept from the tail of an ssh receipt.
config.admission.thresholdTokens: Minimum net tokens a candidate must save before substitution; a single deterministic candidate is exempt.
config.selector.maxTokens: Output budget for the multi-candidate selector; its input plus output bound is deducted from the saving.
config.horizonSteps: Remaining-step horizon used when the session average cannot be computed.
config.historyTurns: Number of recent turns averaged for the step count.
